name: Tiger Road
description: Capcom's action platformer set in medieval China, also known as Tora-he no Michi, ported from the original arcade ROM: a binary port on the Mega Drive, Neo Geo and Saturn, and a full reproduction of the arcade board on the Dreamcast. Japanese, English and Spanish text, and stereo music.
image_alt: Tiger Road artwork: Lee Wong, the bald young warrior monk, crouches with his weapon drawn next to a tiger.

name: Cruis'n USA: Arcade Edition
description: The arcade game, not the N64 one: Midway's V-Unit program translated into native Dreamcast code, with its video and sound hardware replaced by the PowerVR and the AICA, Dreamcast controls, VMU saves and the hidden cars and tracks on a button.
image_alt: Cruis'n USA on the Dreamcast: a bronze 1960s sports car on the grassy verge of the LA freeway, past palm trees.

name: Shadow Warrior: 30th Anniversary Edition
description: A fan port of the Build engine shooter, made from the released source code by way of JFShadowWarrior, with both official expansions, Twin Dragon and Wanton Destruction, built in.
image_alt: Shadow Warrior 30th Anniversary Edition start-up screen with an illustration of Lo Wang and the game's logo.

name: Karnov
description: Data East's fire-breathing strongman, in a binary port of the arcade to the Mega Drive, started as a simpler companion to Tiger Road.
image_alt: Karnov on the Mega Drive: Karnov stands among stone ruins between two tall buildings.
